_doc: Assessment categories. Every category must end up in the report with findings or an explicit 'checked, none found' line naming what was scanned. order = report order. brief = engagement checklist item it answers. segment = report grouping (segments list); categories are ordered by segment.

categories.title: Windows-only APIs (Linux readiness)
categories.scanned: C#/VB/markup for registry, Event Log, WMI, performance counters, System.Drawing, COM, P/Invoke, DirectoryServices, MSMQ, Windows services, DPAPI, CNG/CSP, certificate store, ACLs, shelling out to Windows executables

categories.title: File system and path handling
categories.scanned: drive letters, backslash path literals, MapPath, case mismatches between path literals and files on disk, Windows special folders and %VARS%, local file writes, code pages / Encoding.Default, hard-coded CRLF

categories.title: Time zones and culture
categories.scanned: Windows time-zone IDs, DateTime.Now usage, hard-coded cultures, web.config globalization, culture-sensitive string comparison

categories.title: Inventory and project structure
categories.scanned: solutions, project files, target frameworks, project types, package formats, languages, lines of code

categories.title: .NET Framework technologies unavailable on modern .NET
categories.scanned: AppDomains, Remoting, CAS, EnterpriseServices/COM+, Workflow Foundation, BinaryFormatter, Thread.Abort, CodeDom compilation, reflection-only loading, XSLT script, obsolete WebRequest

categories.title: ASP.NET (System.Web) dependencies
categories.scanned: System.Web, HttpContext.Current, Web Forms pages and controls, Global.asax, HTTP modules/handlers, OWIN, MVC child actions, ASMX, Web Site projects, ReportViewer

categories.title: WCF, WPF, WinForms and other rewrite candidates
categories.scanned: WCF service contracts and bindings, WCF clients and web references, WinForms, WPF, ClickOnce

categories.title: Modern .NET still hosted on Windows
categories.scanned: SDK-style projects on .NET Core/5+ with no Windows-only findings but IIS/Windows hosting artefacts; out-of-support .NET versions

categories.title: NuGet packages and third-party libraries
categories.scanned: packages.config and PackageReference against the package map (Windows-only, deprecated, vulnerable, licence) and, when enabled, api.nuget.org

categories.title: Connectivity and network dependencies
categories.scanned: hard-coded IPs and hosts, internal host names, UNC shares, SMTP, FTP, proxies, WCF client endpoints, outbound URLs

categories.title: Email, reporting, printing and other on-prem integrations
categories.scanned: SMTP clients, printing APIs, fax, Office interop, Crystal Reports, SSRS clients, PDF/Excel libraries, SharePoint, Exchange EWS

categories.title: Upstream and downstream systems
categories.scanned: aggregated from connection strings, URLs, WCF endpoints, SMTP, file shares, queues

categories.title: Data access layer
categories.scanned: EF6/EDMX, System.Data.SqlClient, OLE DB/ODBC, Oracle unmanaged driver, TransactionScope / distributed transactions, SqlDependency, integrated-security connection strings

categories.title: SQL Server features vs Amazon RDS for SQL Server and Babelfish
categories.scanned: T-SQL in .sql files / SSDT projects: CLR, linked servers, xp_cmdshell, FILESTREAM, Service Broker, MSDTC, SQL Agent jobs, cross-database references, BULK INSERT, full-text, MERGE, hierarchyid, temporal tables, XML methods, EXECUTE AS, Database Mail, replication; SSIS/SSRS/SSAS artefacts

categories.title: Authentication and identity
categories.scanned: web.config authentication mode, Windows auth / impersonation, Forms auth, Membership/role manager, machineKey, WS-Federation/ADFS, ASP.NET Identity 2, OWIN security, default network credentials

categories.title: Configuration and secrets
categories.scanned: config transforms, ConfigurationManager usage, connection strings (names, servers, auth type), secret-like settings and literals (values never copied), DPAPI/RSA-protected sections

categories.title: Security and compliance
categories.scanned: TLS/SSL versions, certificate validation overrides, weak hashes/ciphers, request validation off, debug compilation, custom errors off, vulnerable packages and front-end libraries, hard-coded credentials

categories.title: Hosting and IIS dependencies
categories.scanned: IIS rewrite rules, modules/handlers, httpRuntime limits, session state mode, publish profiles (MSDeploy/IIS), Dockerfiles and base images

categories.title: State and horizontal scaling
categories.scanned: in-process session, Application/Cache/MemoryCache state, static mutable fields, in-process timers and background work in web apps, local disk persistence

categories.title: Background processing and scheduling
categories.scanned: Windows services, Task Scheduler, Hangfire, Quartz, MSMQ, timers

categories.title: Logging, monitoring and health
categories.scanned: Event Log, log4net/NLog/Serilog file targets, ELMAH, Trace listeners, health-check endpoints

categories.title: Hypervisor and machine-coupling (Proxmox, VMware, Hyper-V)
categories.scanned: hardware/MAC/BIOS identifiers, machine-name logic, serial/COM/LPT devices, licence dongles, static IPs

categories.title: Build and delivery
categories.scanned: legacy project format, packages.config, WebApplication.targets, pre/post-build events, .bat/.ps1 scripts, CI definitions and Windows agents, private NuGet feeds, signing

categories.title: Automated tests
categories.scanned: test projects, frameworks, test method counts, UI/Coded UI tests

categories.title: Front end
categories.scanned: jQuery/Bootstrap/AngularJS versions, bundling, Web Forms AJAX controls, ViewState, legacy SignalR, bower/npm

categories.title: Parallel development and merge risk
categories.scanned: git history: commits, authors and hot files in the activity window

categories.title: Tooling coverage (what tools find vs manual review)
categories.scanned: which checks are automated here, what AWS Transform / CAST / analyzers add, Linux build validation results

segments.title: Linux readiness
segments.description: Everything that stops the code running on Linux: Windows-only APIs, file system and paths, time zones and culture.

segments.title: .NET modernization
segments.description: Technologies that do not exist on modern .NET: System.Web / Web Forms, WCF, desktop UI, AppDomains, Remoting, project formats, out-of-support frameworks.

segments.title: Packages and libraries
segments.description: NuGet packages: incompatible, deprecated, vulnerable, licence review, private.

segments.title: Third-party APIs and integrations
segments.description: External services, on-premises systems, email, file transfer, reporting and other integrations the app depends on.

segments.title: Data and database
segments.description: Data-access code and SQL Server features versus Amazon RDS / Babelfish.

segments.title: Identity, configuration and security
segments.description: Authentication, secrets, configuration and security posture.

segments.title: Hosting and operations
segments.description: IIS, state and scaling, background jobs, logging, machine coupling.

segments.title: Delivery and quality
segments.description: Build, CI/CD, tests, front end, parallel development, tooling.
